scene.placeText: the golden crescent beach of her far-future city at dawn patrol — rolling surf glowing pink and gold, two tall flags of red and yellow light planted in the sand to mark the guarded water, rescue drones hovering over the waves and a rock-cut ocean pool glowing at the end of the beach
scene.ownProp: a slim rescue float glowing in red and yellow light, its tether coiled at her hip
scene.outfit: a lifesaver-captain look fitted to her body — a sleek high-cut rescue swimsuit split into red and yellow halves glowing along light seams, small flag-shaped panels of red and yellow light at her shoulders, a slim drone holster on a belt at her hip and light water-shoes
scene.scene: she is the patrol captain of the beach's lifesavers, striding along the waterline at dawn with her glowing rescue float in hand, eyes on the surf as she sets the day's flags of red and yellow light

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Australian woman — the personification of Sydney — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Sydney as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Sydney with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the golden crescent beach of her far-future city at dawn patrol — rolling surf glowing pink and gold, two tall flags of red and yellow light planted in the sand to mark the guarded water, rescue drones hovering over the waves and a rock-cut ocean pool glowing at the end of the beach
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a lifesaver-captain look fitted to her body — a sleek high-cut rescue swimsuit split into red and yellow halves glowing along light seams, small flag-shaped panels of red and yellow light at her shoulders, a slim drone holster on a belt at her hip and light water-shoes, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a slim rescue float glowing in red and yellow light, its tether coiled at her hip at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed.
Scene note: she is the patrol captain of the beach's lifesavers, striding along the waterline at dawn with her glowing rescue float in hand, eyes on the surf as she sets the day's flags of red and yellow light

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

qa.anatomy: Both feet are in frame on her walking stride, with the float low in one hand.
